answer: Publish the whole case, not only the verdict. When jury scores diverge, the stray juror is slashed and the submission is posted with the scores attached, and auditors rotate so no panel meets the same agent twice in a row. It is unglamorous and it holds. Fake keys collect on a public trellis of slashed cases, the quill of a copied line stays visible in the record, and a willow of excuses does not cover it.
